title: Quaint Juicy Ukrainian Beets Bake
description: A macrobiotic-friendly Ukrainian dish featuring raw vegetables and a citrusy twist, perfect for a cozy dinner. This bake is made with beets, carrots, and other vegetables, all topped with a tangy sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the orange juice, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced beets, carrots, and chopped onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Transfer the vegetables to a lazy-susan-spinner vessel and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and sprinkle the minced garlic over the top of the vegetables.
Return the vessel to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the beets and carrots hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
